segments.label: Historical heading
segments.original:
CAP. LXVI.
RINOVATIONE
De’ Bandi fatti in diuersi tempi colla sospensione de’ varij luoghi per causa di Peste.
segments.english:
Chapter 66
Renewal
Of proclamations issued at various times suspending different places because of plague.

segments.label: Renewal and incorporation of earlier conditions
segments.original: Perche fin dal 1652. con diuersi Editti si sono bandite, e sospese molte Città, e Prouincie per sospetto di mal Contagioso, e continua tuttauia il bisogno di guardarsi, e di non ammettere le Persone, Animali, Robbe, e Mercantie, che vengono da quelle parti. Per commissione espressa di Nostro Signore se ne rinoua col presente Bando la notitia, ristringendosi qui sotto la nota de’ luoghi sudetti, in ordine alla puntuale osseruanza della dispositione de’ Bandi sudetti colle conditioni, e pene espresse particolarmente in quello publicato li 20. Maggio dell’anno corrente.
segments.english: Because since 1652 various edicts have banned and suspended many cities and provinces on suspicion of contagious disease, and there remains a need to keep watch and not admit persons, animals, belongings and merchandise coming from those parts, by the express commission of Our Lord this proclamation renews notice of those restrictions. A consolidated list of the aforesaid places is given below for exact observance of the proclamations, with the conditions and penalties expressed particularly in the proclamation published on 20 May of the current year.

segments.label: Banned places — left column
segments.original:
BANDITI.
L’Isola di Sardegna.
L’Isola di Maiorica.
La Prouincia di Linguadoca.
Perpignano con tutto il Contado di Rossiglione.
Torox.
Valeimalega.
Frigiliana.
Nerxa.
segments.english:
BANNED.
The island of Sardinia.
The island of Majorca.
The province of Languedoc.
Perpignan with the whole county of Roussillon.
Torox.
Valeimalega.
Frigiliana.
Nerxa.

segments.label: Suspended places — right column
segments.original:
SOSPESI.
L’Isola di Minorica.
La Prouincia del Delfinato, e Principato d’Oranges.
La Catalogna.
L’Isola d’Euizza.
La Città di Malega in Spagna.
La Polonia tutta.
La Città di Danzica.
Costantinopoli con tutte le parti di Leuante.
La Città di Napoli con tutto il suo Regno.
La Terra di Ciuità Vecchia, e
La Terra di Nettunno.
segments.english:
SUSPENDED.
The island of Minorca.
The province of Dauphiné and the Principality of Orange.
Catalonia.
The island of Ibiza.
The city of Málaga in Spain.
All of Poland.
The city of Danzig.
Constantinople with all parts of the Levant.
The city of Naples with its whole kingdom.
The town of Civitavecchia, and
The town of Nettuno.

notes.text: The source prints two parallel columns, headed BANDITI and SOSPESI. They are transcribed separately in column order. The scan reads “La Polonia tutta” (all of Poland), not the OCR’s “Polonia turca”.

The smaller Spanish place-names Torox, Valeimalega and Nerxa are retained as printed, without silently replacing them with proposed modern identifications. “Banned” and “suspended” remain distinct source categories; this list itself does not explain every legal distinction.
